territorial_scope.description: Applies to data centers within Fairfax County, Virginia, under its zoning districts.

evidence.quote: BE IT ORDAINED BY THE BOARD OF SUPERVISORS OF FAIRFAX COUNTY,

summary.short: Amends Fairfax County zoning chapters 112.1 and 112.2 for data centers, effective September II, 2024 (as printed): removes or conditions data center use permissions in several districts and adds siting, noise, and design standards for data center owners and operators.
summary.long: Amends the Fairfax County Zoning Ordinance (Chapters 112.1 and 112.2) on data centers, adopted 10 September 2024 and effective September II, 2024 (as printed). Changes use permissions: data centers become special exceptions (SE) or permitted-or-SE in the 1-4, 1-5 and 1-6 Districts, are removed from the PRC District, and become SE in the PDC and PTC Districts. Revised Sec. 4102.6.A sets siting and design standards: equipment must be fully enclosed or screened; building size is capped at 40,000 sq ft in C-3 and C-4 and 80,000 sq ft in the 1-2 to 1-4 Districts, exceedable by special exception; buildings must be at least 200 feet from R-district or residential lots; equipment must be 300 feet away or separated by the building; buildings must be at least one mile from a Metro station entrance; noise studies are required before site plan approval and after construction; by-right facades must meet entrance and fenestration rules. Rezoning and special exception applications for data centers must include noise studies and architectural depictions. Site plans accepted by July 16, 2024 may be reviewed under prior rules if approved by July 16, 2025, and other earlier approvals may continue.

notes: Amending ordinance: the text of Chapters 112.1 and 112.2 is not reproduced, so only the amendment instructions and inserted text are annotated. Several table cells in the source are garbled (OCR), so only the changes stated in the amendment text are recorded. Table 4101.2: data center permission removed in PRC; PDC and PTC changed to SE. Printed effective date is 'September II, 2024, at 12:01 a.m.' (the day is printed as roman numeral II; not verified). Transitional provisions for site plans, rezonings and permits with data centers accepted or approved on or before July 16, 2024 are added to Appendix 1, subsection 2.B. The text directs renumbering as needed. No enabling statute is cited; adoption is 'in the manner prescribed by law'. Data center applicants and owners are the addressees of the standards but are not named entities.

enforcement.note: The amending text contains no fine, penalty, permit revocation, suspension, clawback, injunction or other sanction provision. It covers Use Table permissions (Tables 4101.1 and 4101.2), data center use-specific standards in 4102.6.A, rezoning and special exception submission requirements in 8101, and transitional provisions for prior approvals. Any enforcement provisions would have to appear in text not reproduced in this document.
